title: log-aggregator
blurb: An on-call log rollup is counting WARN lines as errors and dropping events on the window boundary. Read the tests, fix the aggregator.
brief:
SRE built a tiny log aggregator for paging: ingest structured lines, then return **ERROR** counts per service inside a sliding time window.

Log line format (space-separated, message may contain spaces):

```
2026-08-29T03:10:00Z LEVEL service message words...
```

Two bugs are burning on-call:

1. **WARN** lines are being counted — only **ERROR** should increment the rollup.
2. Events exactly at the **start** of the window (`end - window_seconds`) are dropped — the window should be **inclusive** on both ends.

The tests in `tests/test_aggregator.py` encode the contract. Read them like a spec.

**Your job:** fix `aggregator/window.py` until every test is green.
